summary.text: Steven Howitt is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Bristol District since 2011 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Howitt graduated from the Boston University School of Management with a bachelor's degree in business administration, and his professional experience includes owning an excavation contracting business.
He took office in 2011 and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, Howitt was assigned to the House Ethics Committee, the Steering, Policy and Scheduling Committee (as ranking minority member), the Financial Services Joint Committee (as ranking minority member) and the Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint Committee.
